## Summary

Describe the focused change and why Atlas needs it.

## Safety and provenance

- [ ] Public facts retain citations and source attribution.
- [ ] Unknown, estimated, preliminary, and conflicting states remain explicit.
- [ ] Source terms, retention, and attribution were reviewed if applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or copyrighted article bodies were added.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated and pass.
- [ ] Failure, stale, empty, and recovery states were considered.
- [ ] Documentation, ADRs, OpenAPI, migrations, costs, and operations were updated where applicable.
- [ ] Accessibility was checked for user-interface changes.

## Screenshots or evidence

Include relevant test output, query plans, or before/after screenshots when they materially help review.
